canonicalization_rule: No concrete normalization is accepted until it is proved to instantiate or identify the abstract NBHilbertData objects.

gates.name: space
gates.goal: Construct the chosen concrete real L2 Hilbert space with explicit measure/domain and prove required structure.

gates.name: rho
gates.goal: Define the canonical fractional-part generator family from the selected authoritative Nyman-Beurling/Baez-Duarte normalization and prove measurability/MemLp.

gates.name: chi
gates.goal: Define the canonical target indicator in the same concrete L2 space and prove membership/norm facts actually needed.

gates.name: spans
gates.goal: Identify concrete finite spans of the first N generators with NBHilbertData.V under the concrete instance.

gates.name: distance
gates.goal: Identify abstract dN with the concrete residual norm and abstract DN with its square; do not redefine DN.

gates.name: identification
gates.goal: Package the concrete NBHilbertData instance/isometric identification and prove chi, generators, V, projection, dN, DN and DNLimit correspondence.

external_criterion.rule: State and formalize the exact published criterion only after R0.6 fixes normalization. Never use the criterion to prove DNLimit=0 unconditionally.

R1.intended_obligation: DNLimit = 0 or the exact equivalent determined by R0
